rationale: Both reviews are unusually rigorous, with extensive file:line grounding and explicit claim verification. X more directly matches the ground-truth reviewer asks: its major finding on platform.py:253 mirrors hsliuustc0106's scope concern almost exactly (Cosmos3-only override, per-model hook suggestion), and it explicitly names test_qwen_image_2512_matches_diffusers_pixelwise as the missing accuracy report alongside latency, hitting hsliuustc0106's second comment verbatim. Y's scope finding is even more thorough (independently derives nearly the same affected-model list NumberWan later posted) but misses the explicit pixelwise-accuracy ask, and its strongest finding (Part 1 becomes a no-op for Qwen-Image after Part 2) is a novel, well-verified insight that no GT reviewer raised, so it doesn't add recall. Neither candidate flags Gaohan123's 'pytest mark is not complete' comment. X edges ahead on actionability via literal ```suggestion``` diff blocks applicable as-is, while Y's fixes are equally concrete but more narrative.
